THEFLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_STRIKE.title: Strike
THEFLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_DEFEND.title: Defend
THEFLAGELLANT-FLAGELLANT_SCOURGE.title: Scourge
THEFLAGELLANT-PENANCE.title: Penance
THEFLAGELLANT-FLOG.title: Flog
THEFLAGELLANT-BRACE.title: Brace
THEFLAGELLANT-FLAY.title: Flay
THEFLAGELLANT-WHIPLASH.title: Whiplash
THEFLAGELLANT-WHIPLASH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add an [gold]Injury[/gold] to your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-VIGILANCE.title: Vigilance
THEFLAGELLANT-VIGILANCE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Add a [gold]Poor Sleep[/gold] to your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-MALEDICT.title: Maledict
THEFLAGELLANT-MALEDICT.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each [gold]Curse[/gold] you have.
THEFLAGELLANT-JINX.title: Jinx
THEFLAGELLANT-JINX.description: Add a random [gold]Curse[/gold] to your deck. Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-INDULGENCE.title: Indulgence
THEFLAGELLANT-INDULGENCE.description: Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold]. Lose {LoseEnergyNextTurnPower} [gold]Energy[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
THEFLAGELLANT-SACKCLOTH.title: Sackcloth
THEFLAGELLANT-FLAIL.title: Flail
THEFLAGELLANT-LAMENT.title: Lament
THEFLAGELLANT-LAMENT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Gain {PenancePower} [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-CONFESSION.title: Confession
THEFLAGELLANT-CONFESSION.description: Gain {PenancePower} [gold]Penance[/gold]. Apply [gold]Penance[/gold] equal to your [gold]Penance[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: plus {Bonus:diff()}|}.
THEFLAGELLANT-FERVOR.title: Fervor
THEFLAGELLANT-FERVOR.description: Gain {Stats:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {Stats:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] until end of turn.
THEFLAGELLANT-TOUGH_SKIN.title: Tough Skin
THEFLAGELLANT-LITANY.title: Litany
THEFLAGELLANT-LITANY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Resilience[/gold] you have.
THEFLAGELLANT-REVELATION.title: Revelation
THEFLAGELLANT-REVELATION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw a card for each [gold]Resilience[/gold] you have.
THEFLAGELLANT-CATHARSIS.title: Catharsis
THEFLAGELLANT-MANTRA.title: Mantra
THEFLAGELLANT-CATECHISM.title: Catechism
THEFLAGELLANT-TRIBULATION.title: Tribulation
THEFLAGELLANT-DEVOTION.title: Devotion
THEFLAGELLANT-JUDGEMENT.title: Judgement
THEFLAGELLANT-WELTS.title: Welts
THEFLAGELLANT-WELTS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies {Times:diff()} times.
THEFLAGELLANT-MORTIFY.title: Mortify
THEFLAGELLANT-REPRISAL.title: Reprisal
THEFLAGELLANT-REPRISAL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Curse[/gold] in your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-REBUKE.title: Rebuke
THEFLAGELLANT-REBUKE.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Curse[/gold] from your hand. If you do, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THEFLAGELLANT-RELAPSE.title: Relapse
THEFLAGELLANT-RELAPSE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. When you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold], return this to your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-OVERREACH.title: Overreach
THEFLAGELLANT-OVERREACH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Put a [gold]Clumsy[/gold] into your draw pile and discard pile.
THEFLAGELLANT-DEEP_PRAYER.title: Deep Prayer
THEFLAGELLANT-DEEP_PRAYER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Put {Cards:diff()} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Curses|Curse}[/gold] from your draw pile into your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-WEAK_GRIP.title: Weak Grip
THEFLAGELLANT-WEAK_GRIP.description: At the start of each turn, add a [gold]Clumsy[/gold] to your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-RETRIBUTION.title: Retribution
THEFLAGELLANT-RETRIBUTION.description: Every {RetributionPower:inverseDiff()} [gold]Curses[/gold] you create, deal {Damage} damage to all enemies.
THEFLAGELLANT-PREMONITION.title: Premonition
THEFLAGELLANT-PREMONITION.description: The first time you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold] each turn, draw {PremonitionPower:diff()} cards.
THEFLAGELLANT-SHARED_SUFFERING.title: Shared Suffering
THEFLAGELLANT-SHARED_SUFFERING.descripti: When a [gold]Curse[/gold] applies a [gold]Debuff[/gold] to you, also apply it to all enemies.
THEFLAGELLANT-CLOAK_OF_SINS.title: Cloak of Sins
THEFLAGELLANT-CLOAK_OF_SINS.description: For each [gold]Curse[/gold] in your hand, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-RENOUNCE.title: Renounce
THEFLAGELLANT-RENOUNCE.description: [gold]Discard[/gold] any number of [gold]Curses[/gold]. Draw that many cards plus {Cards:diff()}.
THEFLAGELLANT-GALVANIZE.title: Galvanize
THEFLAGELLANT-GALVANIZE.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Curse[/gold] from your hand. If you do, gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-FLINCH.title: Flinch
THEFLAGELLANT-FLINCH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you created a [gold]Curse[/gold] this turn, gain {BonusBlock} more [gold]Block[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-MANIA.title: Mania
THEFLAGELLANT-MANIA.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Draw until you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold]. You cannot draw more cards this turn.
THEFLAGELLANT-SYMPATHY.title: Sympathy
THEFLAGELLANT-SYMPATHY.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Penance[/gold] to yourself, deal {SympathyPower:diff()} damage to all enemies for each stack applied.
THEFLAGELLANT-DISCIPLINE.title: Discipline
THEFLAGELLANT-DISCIPLINE.description: At the start of each turn, gain {DisciplinePower:diff()} [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-LUCIDITY.title: Lucidity
THEFLAGELLANT-INDIGNATION.title: Indignation
THEFLAGELLANT-INDIGNATION.description: Gain {PenancePower:diff()} [gold]Penance[/gold]. Gain [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to the number of unique [gold]Debuffs[/gold] on you.
THEFLAGELLANT-DELIRIUM.title: Delirium
THEFLAGELLANT-DELIRIUM.description: This turn, [gold]Penance[/gold] is doubled on you and your [gold]Attacks[/gold] deal {DeliriumPower:diff()} times damage.
THEFLAGELLANT-CULL.title: Cull
THEFLAGELLANT-CULL.description: [gold]Discard[/gold] any number of cards. Gain that much [gold]Penance[/gold] and draw that many cards.
THEFLAGELLANT-GRIT.title: Grit
THEFLAGELLANT-GRIT.description: This turn, whenever you gain [gold]Penance[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-BREAKING_POINT.title: Breaking Point
THEFLAGELLANT-BREAKING_POINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Costs 1 less for each [gold]Debuff[/gold] applied this turn.
THEFLAGELLANT-OUTBURST.title: Outburst
THEFLAGELLANT-OUTBURST.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each [gold]Penance[/gold] you have.
THEFLAGELLANT-AGGRAVATE.title: Aggravate
THEFLAGELLANT-AGGRAVATE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Double the [gold]Penance[/gold] on the target and yourself.
THEFLAGELLANT-ONSLAUGHT.title: Onslaught
THEFLAGELLANT-ONSLAUGHT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X{IfUpgraded:show: plus {BonusHits:diff()}|} times. Gain X [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-DEFIANCE.title: Defiance
THEFLAGELLANT-DEFIANCE.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Resilience[/gold], deal {DefiancePower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
THEFLAGELLANT-CONVICTION.title: Conviction
THEFLAGELLANT-RESOLUTE_STRIKE.title: Resolute Strike
THEFLAGELLANT-BOLSTERING_BLOW.title: Bolstering Blow
THEFLAGELLANT-UPRISING.title: Uprising
THEFLAGELLANT-UPRISING.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to all enemies X{IfUpgraded:show: + {BonusHits:diff()}|} times.
THEFLAGELLANT-DESPERATION.title: Desperation
THEFLAGELLANT-DESPERATION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. Deal it an additional time for each [gold]Resilience[/gold] lost this turn.
THEFLAGELLANT-REINFORCE.title: Reinforce
THEFLAGELLANT-REINFORCE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. If you have [gold]Resilience[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] again.
THEFLAGELLANT-REGROUP.title: Regroup
THEFLAGELLANT-REGROUP.description: Draw cards equal to [gold]Resilience[/gold] lost this turn{IfUpgraded:show: plus {CalculationBase:diff()}|}.
THEFLAGELLANT-GIRD.title: Gird
THEFLAGELLANT-CONDESCEND.title: Condescend
THEFLAGELLANT-CONDESCEND.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. This turn, take 25% less attack damage from enemies with [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-MUTTER.title: Mutter
THEFLAGELLANT-LACERATE.title: Lacerate
THEFLAGELLANT-LAY_BARE.title: Lay Bare
THEFLAGELLANT-LAY_BARE.description: Remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] from an enemy. Apply {PenancePower:diff()} [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-EXTOLL.title: Extoll
THEFLAGELLANT-EXTOLL.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Increases by {ExtraDamage} for each [gold]Penance[/gold] on the enemy.
THEFLAGELLANT-RAPTURE.title: Rapture
THEFLAGELLANT-RAPTURE.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for each [gold]Penance[/gold] on the enemy, then remove all [gold]Penance[/gold] from it.
THEFLAGELLANT-COMPULSION.title: Compulsion
THEFLAGELLANT-COMPULSION.description: At the end of your turn, play a random [gold]Skill[/gold] in your hand.
THEFLAGELLANT-EXORCISE.title: Exorcise
THEFLAGELLANT-EXORCISE.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Curses[/gold] in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Curse[/gold] exhausted.
THEFLAGELLANT-MAELSTROM.title: Maelstrom
THEFLAGELLANT-MAELSTROM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Costs 1 less for each [gold]Curse[/gold] you have.
THEFLAGELLANT-ANATHEMA.title: Anathema
THEFLAGELLANT-REDEMPTION.title: Redemption
THEFLAGELLANT-REDEMPTION.description: Remove all [gold]Penance[/gold] from yourself. Deal {ExtraDamage} damage to all enemies for each [gold]Penance[/gold] removed.
THEFLAGELLANT-RECKONING.title: Reckoning
THEFLAGELLANT-RECKONING.description: Remove all [gold]Penance[/gold] from everyone. Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage to all enemies for each [gold]Penance[/gold] removed.
THEFLAGELLANT-EXALTATION.title: Exaltation
THEFLAGELLANT-EXALTATION.description: This turn, [gold]Debuffs[/gold] applied to you are prevented.
THEFLAGELLANT-CROWN_OF_THORNS.title: Crown of Thorns
THEFLAGELLANT-MARTYR.title: Martyr
THEFLAGELLANT-MARTYR.description: If a [gold]Debuff[/gold] would be applied to an ally, apply it to you instead.
THEFLAGELLANT-SMITE.title: Smite
THEFLAGELLANT-TRIUMPH.title: Triumph
THEFLAGELLANT-TRIUMPH.description: Remove all [gold]Penance[/gold] from yourself. Gain that much [gold]Resilience[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-PERSEVERANCE.title: Perseverance
THEFLAGELLANT-PERSEVERANCE.description: At the start of each turn, gain {PerseverancePower:diff()} [gold]Resilience[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-MANIFESTATION.title: Manifestation
THEFLAGELLANT-MANIFESTATION.description: Gain {ResiliencePower:diff()} [gold]Resilience[/gold]. Your [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] are equal to your [gold]Resilience[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-VOW.title: Vow
THEFLAGELLANT-PROSELYTIZE.title: Proselytize
THEFLAGELLANT-FORTITUDE.title: Fortitude
THEFLAGELLANT-FORTITUDE.description: The first time you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold] each turn, gain {FortitudePower} [gold]Resilience[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-CONSUMPTION.title: Consumption
THEFLAGELLANT-CONSUMPTION.description: At the {IfUpgraded:show:start|end} of the enemy turn, enemies take damage equal to their [gold]Penance[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-TRANSCENDENT_FORM.title: Transcendent Form
THEFLAGELLANT-TRANSCENDENT_FORM.descript: [gold]Attacks[/gold] apply [gold]Penance[/gold] equal to {TranscendentFormPower:diff()} times their unblocked damage.
THEFLAGELLANT-TENDERIZE.title: Tenderize
THEFLAGELLANT-TENDERIZE.description: Gain {TenderizePower:diff()} [gold]Tenderize[/gold]. Enemies with [gold]Penance[/gold] take 25% more attack damage per stack of [gold]Tenderize[/gold].
THEFLAGELLANT-ORIGINAL_SIN.title: Original Sin
